verses.2:
Day after day they pour forth speech;
 night after night they reveal knowledge.
verses.3:
Without speech or language,
 without a sound to be heard, + 19:3 Or There is no speech or language where their voice is not heard
verses.4:
their voice + 19:4 LXX, Syriac, and Vulgate; Hebrew their measuring line has gone out into all the earth,
 their words to the ends of the world. + 19:4 Cited in Romans 10:18|ROM 10:18 
 In the heavens He has pitched
 a tent for the sun.
verses.5:
Like a bridegroom emerging from his chamber,
 like a champion rejoicing to run his course,
verses.7:
The Law of the LORD is perfect,
 reviving the soul;
 the testimony of the LORD is trustworthy,
 making wise the simple.
verses.8:
The precepts of the LORD are right,
 bringing joy to the heart;
 the commandments of the LORD are radiant,
 giving light to the eyes.
verses.9:
The fear of the LORD is pure,
 enduring forever;
 the judgments of the LORD are true,
 being altogether righteous.
verses.10:
They are more precious than gold,
 than much pure gold;
 they are sweeter than honey,
 than honey from the comb.
verses.11:
By them indeed Your servant is warned;
 in keeping them is great reward.
verses.12:
Who can discern his own errors?
 Cleanse me from my hidden faults.
verses.13:
Keep Your servant also from willful sins;
 may they not rule over me.
 Then I will be blameless
 and cleansed of great transgression.
verses.14:
May the words of my mouth
 and the meditation of my heart
 be pleasing in Your sight,
 O LORD, my Rock and my Redeemer.
